liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Knockin' on Heavens Door** (2 other sources): About 5:30 in, video screens showed crew and band members who had died, ending with Jerry [2][3]

## The recordings

- **20230715_20230715_0832** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 186 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener says the closing track of this recording contains only crowd noise, not the song itself [9]
- **deadco2023-07-14.sennmke4010.mbhoka200.flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 188 min [2]
- **deadco2023-07-14.mbhoka200.zoomf8pro.flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 189 min [3]
- **deadco2023-07-14.jdwtyl**: source not stated; 20 songs; 186 min [4]

## Around the show

- Uploader promoted a charity shirt supporting the National Brain Tumor Society; lineup listed Weir, Mayer and Burbridge [1]
- Listener says the show was emotional for many in attendance [8]
- Listener notes a second night at the venue was coming the same evening [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **20230715_20230715_0832**: taped by Eric Lugassy; transferred by Eric Lugassy; source: Channels 1 & 2: AKG c414 XLII Hypercardioids PAS 20" apart > Channels 3 & 4: Audio Technica 3031 Cardioids PAS 32" apart > Channels 5 & 6: Vanguard V1… [1]. Also: Taped with AKG c414, Audio Technica 3031 and Vanguard V1 microphones, then converted to 24-bit FLAC via Reaper [1]
- **deadco2023-07-14.sennmke4010.mbhoka200.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: SennMS14P/mke4010 (dina)+MBHOka200 (dina)->Zoom F8Pro(48/32) [2]. Also: Transferred from SDXC through Cakewalk Sonar and Sound Forge to 24-bit FLAC [2]
- **deadco2023-07-14.mbhoka200.zoomf8pro.flac24**: taped by Bob Crupi; transferred by Bob Crupi; source: MBHOka200 (dina)->Zoom F8Pro(48/32) [3]. Also: Bob Crupi recorded with MBHO KA200 mics and a Zoom F8 Pro from the back of the home dugout; Transferred from SDXC through Sound Forge, converted to 24-bit with iZotope MBIT+ dither, and encoded as FLAC [3]
- **deadco2023-07-14.jdwtyl**: taped by Jay; transferred by Jay; source: Schoeps CMC622 + Schoeps CMC641>Sound Devices MixPre 6ii [4]
